positions.title: Expert Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop software for the network analyzer team, specializing in calibration and correction, fixturing, balanced measurements, noise figure measurements as well as support and development on intermodulation distortion, and phase noise applications.  Work includes everything from measurement development, software design, and UI elements (both remote and graphical).  Projects include both large-scale hardware and software projects on international teams as well as smaller scale individual projects.  Closely collaborate and support external customers on their measurement needs.

positions.title: Advanced Software Engineer
positions.description: Employed in the New Product Introduction/Manufacturing group creating and modifying test software for network analyzers to ensure that products meet warrantied and typical specifications.  Work includes measurement design, test process improvement, uncertainty analysis, environmental studies, specification setting, and quality control.  Test software written in multiple languages in multiple MS Windows environments including custom RF instrument drivers.  Participated in company-wide “Optimize Test” initiative, helping to develop several new measurements and resulting in a patent.  Traveled to assist in product line transfers to manufacturing center in Penang, Malaysia.  Support production lines in both Santa Rosa, CA and Penang, MY including the auditing process for various certifications.   Extensive experience working with and debugging issues with network analyzers, both high-performance and handheld.  Mentored new software engineers.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: High Energy Physics.  Researched at CERN on the CMS Experiment.  Thesis:  Search for Supersymmetry with Diphoton Events in 7 TeV pp Collisions at the Compact Muon Solenoid
